(Search snippet content — full article 403'd on direct fetch; CNBC/CNN carrying Trump's verbatim social-media post)
Trump wrote on social media: "From this point forward, any time the Islamic Republic of Iran shoots at a ship in the Strait of Hormuz, whether it be by Missile, Rocket, Drone, or any other device or weapon, the United States will bomb and destroy ONE BRIDGE OR POWER PLANT." Those targets include "those located next to, or in, the Capital City of Tehran."
The warning came after the U.S. carried out another wave of strikes on Iran, where air defenses opened fire over the capital, Tehran. US struck a military site near Tabriz, the first time the area is thought to have been hit since hostilities worsened. Trump reiterated threats to strike "very soon and very hard" at Pickaxe Mountain, a suspected underground nuclear site near Natanz where Israel believes Tehran has stored part of its enriched uranium stockpile and advanced centrifuges. Secretary of State Marco Rubio questioned Iran's willingness to negotiate; Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth told lawmakers the conflict has cost the US more than $37.5 billion.
